x: Pointer, who has scored in our team previously, was our third man to finish; Merryman, our fourth man home, deserves much praise, as I hear from Dick Savage that he has only been in training a month or so.
Martin took first place, with Stimpson second, and Merryman third (dead-heat). Frank Webb, snaky as ever, managed to spoil our juniors' exclusiveness by dead-heating for third place.
We have, of course, three members of last year's winning team still available, and backed up by Wood, Chamberlain, Quackenbos, Merryman and Pointer, they can scarcely fail to do well.
